CSDA Evaluation Image Footprints

Interactive map of footprints of images available for CSDA SME Evaluations

These are imagery delivered in response to CSDA requests at sites from the CSDA Evaluation Sites Database.

Each image footprint:

  • is located at a CSDA Evaluation Site named using a unique identifier (Site Name)
  • has geometric bounds representing the acauisition extent
  • includes basic attributes associated with the image acquisition

Image footprint geometry should completely cover an site AOI. Mouse over footprints for acquisition details.

Work in progress — some images were not properly footprinted and are missing from this map. Contact: paul.m.montesano@nasa.gov
